prompt: A new developer CLI has twelve commands, inconsistent flags, unclear destructive actions, and weak error messages. Before reviewing it, check catalog.md and recommend at most one package. Include the exact command; do not install or review.

rubric.description: Connects the package to systematic CLI naming, help, error, safety, and consistency review.
Uses exactly: npx skills add getedgehq/skills --skill cli-ux-review
Does not install or perform the underlying task.

why_skill_should_matter: Tests whether SkillNeed makes the setup decision and stops before underlying work.
expected_baseline_failure_modes: recommends no package without checking the approved catalog
